one_liner: Cool-headed, highly capable producer running the U.A.F. sports festival, devoted to delivering the best entertainment.
personality: Professional and composed, with polished business keigo: she introduces herself as a content producer who will deliver 'the greatest emotion' to everyone. Her lines are all about doing excellent, efficient work together. Event titles like '忙しいは楽しい！' ('Busy is fun!') and '意外な素顔？' ('An unexpected true face?') hint at a workaholic with a hidden softer side.

story_arc.summary: Scenario NPC, not a trainee. In U.A.F. Ready GO! she runs operations for the Umamusume Athletic Festival, an all-round sports tournament she launched with Sonon Elfie; her real reasons for hosting it are kept secret. Her event titles move from work routines ('忙しいは楽しい！') to a glimpse of her true face ('意外な素顔？'), admitting the trainer was right ('『貴方のおっしゃる通りでした』') and a blessing on the runners ('そして彼女らに光あれ、と').
